package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumOnboardingTurnRequestBytes = 16 << 10

func (client Client) ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx context.Context, studentID string, command domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(command)
	if err != nil || !validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return client.doTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, http.MethodPost, studentID, normalized.StudentCommandID, "", normalized)
}

func (client Client) GetTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentCommandID string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	if !validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(studentID) || !validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(studentCommandID) {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return client.doTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, http.MethodGet, studentID, studentCommandID, "", nil)
}

func (client Client) ProveTeacherOnboardingTurnNoEffect(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentCommandID string, proof domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	if !validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(studentID) || !validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(studentCommandID) || proof.Schema != domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingProofSchema || proof.Command.StudentCommandID != studentCommandID {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if _, err := domain.NewTeacherStudentOnboardingTurnCommand(proof.Command); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	return client.doTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx, http.MethodPost, studentID, studentCommandID, "/prove-no-effect", proof)
}

func (client Client) doTeacherOnboardingTurn(ctx context.Context, method, studentID, commandID, suffix string, value any) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	path := "/internal/v1/teacher/students/" + url.PathEscape(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) + "/onboarding/turns/" + url.PathEscape(strings.TrimSpace(commandID))
	if method == http.MethodPost && suffix == "" {
		path = "/internal/v1/teacher/students/" + url.PathEscape(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) + "/onboarding/turns"
	}
	path += suffix
	endpoint, err := client.endpointWithToken(path, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, err
	}
	var body *bytes.Reader
	if value != nil {
		encoded, marshalErr := json.Marshal(value)
		if marshalErr != nil || len(encoded) > maximumOnboardingTurnRequestBytes {
			return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
		}
		body = bytes.NewReader(encoded)
	} else {
		body = bytes.NewReader(nil)
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, body)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	if method == http.MethodPost {
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", commandID)
	}
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingTurnUnknown
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, mapOnboardingStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var result domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &result); err != nil || !validStudentOnboardingTurnResult(result, commandID) {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	return err == nil
}

func validStudentOnboardingTurnResult(result domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResult, commandID string) bool {
	if result.Schema != domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema || result.StudentCommandID != commandID || !validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(result.CanonicalStudentMessageID) {
		return false
	}
	switch result.StudentEffectState {
	case "accepted":
		return result.ResultDraftVersion != nil && *result.ResultDraftVersion >= 1 && result.NoEffectProofID == nil &&
			(result.ResultProfileVersion == nil || *result.ResultProfileVersion >= 0)
	case "no_effect":
		return result.ResultDraftVersion == nil && result.ResultProfileVersion == nil && result.NoEffectProofID != nil && validStudentOnboardingTurnUUID(*result.NoEffectProofID)
	default:
		return false
	}
}

var _ repository.TeacherStudentOnboardingTurnGateway = Client{}
